description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific board star (a Trello board marked as a favorite) for a given Trello member.

idBoardStar.description: The unique identifier of the board star. Each starred board has a unique ID, which is used to fetch its specific details.
idBoardStar.title: Id Board Star

idMember.description: The ID or username of the Trello member. This specifies whose board star information is being retrieved.
idMember.title: Id Member

name: get_members_board_stars_by_id_member_by_id_board_star

BoardStarData.description: Details of a specific board star.

id.description: The unique identifier of the board star.
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: The ID of the board that has been starred.
idBoard.title: Id Board

pos.description: The position of the board star, used to determine display order. Lower values appear first.
pos.title: Pos

BoardStarData.title: BoardStarData

data.description: The board star details including its ID, the associated board ID, and the position.
data.title: Data
